bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$root"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
test "$(sha256sum scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 73c8d2776601c37964f3d833f43ca4224f1506563f1ec08722b4fb0cb0a5014e
test "$(sha256sum scripts/userbot_test_client.py | cut -d' ' -f1)" = 9c7ac8f91e40a9d27b830d36d1f227542391022fd80a1e6e2c3bb84076e6d02f
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cp -p scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py "$tmp/ipc.py"
cp -p scripts/userbot_test_client.py "$tmp/client.py"
deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py")
s=p.read_text()
old='"bot_start_menu", "room_private_smoke"'
if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit("IPC_ACTION_ANCHOR_MISMATCH")
s=s.replace(old,'"bot_start_menu", "profile_button_smoke", "room_private_smoke"',1)
old='            labels = [[b.text for b in row] for row in latest.buttons]\n            return {'
if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit("IPC_BUTTON_ANCHOR_MISMATCH")
new='''            labels = [[b.text for b in row] for row in latest.buttons]
            if action == "profile_button_smoke":
                from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
                if labels != EXPECTED_MENU:
                    raise RuntimeError("PROFILE_MENU_LAYOUT_INVALID")
                clicked_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
                await latest.click(text="プロフ作成")
                for _ in range(12):
                    recent = await client.get_messages(bot, limit=80)
                    for screen in recent:
                        if screen.out or "プロフィール｜相手募集と共通入力" not in (screen.raw_text or ""):
                            continue
                        updated_at = screen.edit_date or screen.date
                        if updated_at and updated_at >= clicked_at - timedelta(seconds=2):
                            return {"request_id": request_id, "action": action,
                                    "status": "PASS", "profile_editor_opened": True}
                    await asyncio.sleep(1)
                raise RuntimeError("PROFILE_BUTTON_SCREEN_NOT_OPENED")
            return {'''
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
p=Path("scripts/userbot_test_client.py")
s=p.read_text()
old='        if args.action == "profile_topics_readback":'
if s.count(old)!=1: raise SystemExit("CLIENT_ANCHOR_MISMATCH")
new='''        if args.action == "profile_button_smoke":
            if result.get("profile_editor_opened") is not True:
                raise RuntimeError("PROFILE_BUTTON_SCREEN_NOT_OPENED")
            print("USERBOT_PROFILE_BUTTON=PASS")
        if args.action == "profile_topics_readback":'''
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python -m py_compile scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py
restore(){
 cp -p "$tmp/ipc.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
 cp -p "$tmp/client.py" scripts/userbot_test_client.py
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
if ! systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null; then restore; exit 81; fi
sleep 3
if ! deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python scripts/userbot_test_client.py health > "$tmp/health"; then restore; exit 82; fi
if ! deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python scripts/userbot_test_client.py profile_button_smoke > "$tmp/button"; then
 { echo PROFILE_LIVE_BUTTON=FAIL; cat "$tmp/button"; echo CODE_ROLLBACK=STARTED; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
 restore; exit 83
fi
{ echo PROFILE_LIVE_BUTTON=PASS; cat "$tmp/button"; echo USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service); echo USERBOT_ENABLED=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service); echo USERBOT_HEALTH=$(grep -o 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS' "$tmp/health"); echo VIDEO_ACTIONS_PRESERVED=$(grep -q list_channel_videos scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py && echo yes || echo no); } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
